# L&M Enterprises & SAGO Gas Bar

> Convenience store, tobacco, vape shop, and full-service gas bar located on Tyendinaga Mohawk Territory in Deseronto, Ontario.

## Core Information
- **Business Name:** L&M Enterprises (Store) & SAGO Gas Bar (Pumps)
- **Address:** 39–43 Dundas Street, Deseronto, Ontario, K0K 1X0, Canada
- **Telephone:** +1-613-396-2224
- **Operating Hours:** Open 7 days a week, 6:00 AM – 10:00 PM
- **Location & Access:** Situated on Dundas Street / Highway 49, accessible from Highway 401 via Exit 566 (Marysville) or Exit 570 (Deseronto). Serving Tyendinaga, Deseronto, Napanee, Shannonville, Belleville, and Prince Edward County drivers.

## Fuel Services (SAGO Gas Bar)
- **Pumps:** Full-service pumping (friendly attendants pump your fuel).
- **Available Fuel Types:**
  - Regular Unleaded Gasoline (87 octane)
  - Premium Gasoline (91 octane)
  - Clear Diesel (highway diesel for trucks, SUVs, passenger cars)
  - Dyed Diesel (tax-exempt agricultural, commercial, and off-road equipment)
- **Tax Exemption:** Point-of-sale tax exemption available for registered First Nations Indian Status cardholders.
- **Pricing:** Posted fuel prices are shown at `/gas-station-deseronto` and `/gas-prices`. Check the displayed last-updated date and call +1-613-396-2224 to confirm current pump prices.

## Store Offerings (L&M Enterprises)
- **Tobacco & Cigarettes:** Canadian Classics, BB, DK's, Playfare's, Putters, Rolled Gold, cigars, and pipe tobacco.
- **Vapes & Nicotine Pouches:** Disposable vapes, pods, e-liquids, and nicotine pouches (Zolt, White Fox, Siberia, etc.).
- **Convenience & Snacks:** Cold beverages, fresh coffee, confectioneries, chips, ice, automotive essentials, and propane tank exchange.
- **Payment Methods:** Cash, Debit, Visa, MasterCard. ATM on site.
